text:
jordy: Quick heads-up 1: we flipped the q6b-int4 profile onto newmodel-3 in the perf lab for throughput verification. Results look great for tokens/sec (+2.5x) but our paraphrase recall metric tanked ~22% on the paraphrase testbank. Failing ids -> s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/v4/fails.txt :confused:

sam: Oof. Did you check tokenizer canonicalization (byte-level) and truncation policy? Small prefix changes can cause identical early token sequences. Which tokenizer version was used in the build vs eval runner?

jordy: Tokenizer is v2.2 in both places. I did a quick scan and saw many pairs where the first 6 tokens match exactly after quant run. Quick stat I added to the eval: pair_identical_first_6_tokens = 0.32 (baseline was 0.05).

anya: That metric spike is a good signal. Could be KV caching + rounding-induced token normalization in the int4 kernel. Before we loop infra, can we rule out dataset duplication? Run a dedupe with our fuzz signature at 0.82 and see how many anchors collapse.

jordy: Running dedupe now. Command: 
```
curate dedupe --manifest s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/v4/manifest.json \
  --out s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/v4/dedup-0.82.json --fuzz 0.82 --keep 4000
```

labelops_bot: Label queue created: queue_id=lab-q-2026-03-24-11, size=920, sampler=paraphrase-fuzz-0.82, priority=urgent

marta: We can take 460/day if we pare down context. I'll shard into two sets and mark "hard-merge" candidates with a review flag. ETA first shard tomorrow morning PST. Also I'll reserve 300 slots in the golden review pool for synthetic anchors if you want to add them.

sam: To triangulate infra vs dataset quickly, try a fallback run with the FP16 backend and also enable KV-debug trace. Example command: 
```
./eval_run --model newmodel-3:q6b-int4 --prompts s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/v4/manifest.json \
  --out ./runs/newmodel3-q6b-int4-debug.json --kv-debug --quant-backend fp16
```

jordy: FP16 fallback finished. Paraphrase recall restores to within 3% of baseline. Upload: s3://redwood-runs/newmodel3/q6b-int4-fp16-debug-6823456789.json. Traces show many identical KV prefixes on int4 run but not on fp16.

runtime-ci: Noted. We built a canary kernel earlier this cycle with an alternative rounding mode (canary id: canary-2026-03-24-a7). Try a run with the canary flag `--quant-round=nearest-even` and see if that matches fp16. If it does, we can push a minor kernel update.

sam: Also add a lightweight metric to eval: fraction_of_pairs_with_identical_kv_prefix (first 12 tokens) so we can track it in the console trendline.

jordy: Will add the metric. Meanwhile marta, please proceed with the labeler shards and push the dedup-reduced anchor list into the lab queue. Marta: confirm you got the queue id?

marta: Got it (lab-q-2026-03-24-11). Shards assigned: shardA=460, shardB=460. Instruction doc: short context + decide merge/keep + flag ambiguous as "review". Progress link: https://labels.redwood/queues/lab-q-2026-03-24-11

labelops_bot: Queue update: shardA in progress (started), shardB queued.

sam: If runtime can get the canary kernel validated quickly we might patch rather than expand the golden set. But we should also augment the golden anchors with targeted synthetic perturbations (swap near-prefix tokens, small edit ops) so we avoid regressions on rollout. Jordy: can you prototype 150 synthetics and add them to the golden review pool?

jordy: I'll generate 150 synthetic paraphrases (small edit distance, token-sub swaps) and inject into s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/v4/synthetics/proto-150.json and push to the queue. Command I'll use: 
```
python tools/synth_paraphrase.py --input s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/v4/golden.json \
  --out s3://redwood-curation/paraphrase/v4/synthetics/proto-150.json --n 150 --ops swap,del,sub
```

runtime-ci: We can run the canary with `--quant-round=nearest-even` today; I'll coordinate a 2-hour window with infra. If results match FP16, we'll schedule a kernel patch and re-run the full regression suite.

marta: First shard progress: 120 done, 340 remaining. I'll post another update in 12hrs.

jordy: Blocking auto-rollout of q6b-int4 profile for newmodel-3 until either kernel patch or relabel/augment + regression pass. Thanks all.
